title: Schema-Aware Linker Candidate Filtering Policy
purpose: Conservative MedCAT candidate filtering before creating supervised CUI/assertion targets from MIMIC notes.

security.run_policy: All MIMIC and MedCAT processing must run under SLURM, not on login nodes.
security.output_policy: Write only bounded snippets/candidate metadata; chmod output files to 600 and output directories to 700.
security.raw_note_policy: Do not write full notes to reports, memory, or chat.

preferred_linker.name: MedCAT v2 SNOMED/UMLS modelpack
preferred_linker.rationale: The licensed MIMIC-trained MedCAT pack has broad EHR coverage across diagnoses, findings, labs/vitals, medications, procedures, anatomy, devices, and social/family context. Raw output is too permissive for direct labels.

fallback_linker.name: scispaCy UMLS EntityLinker
fallback_linker.rationale: Broad UMLS coverage but high false-positive risk on clinical abbreviations and generic words.

id_system_warning.final_training_need: If the downstream target must be UMLS CUI format, add a SNOMED-to-UMLS mapping step before emitting final CUI/assertion pairs.
id_system_warning.candidate_field_policy: Candidate files should use concept_id and concept_id_system rather than pretending every ID is a UMLS CUI.

actions.keep_candidate: Clinically meaningful candidate that can be passed to NuExtract/manual review as a possible target.
actions.review_candidate: Potentially useful but ambiguous; include with warning flags, not as an automatic target.
actions.reject_candidate: Do not pass as a target candidate, except in bounded reject-audit examples.
actions.value_parse: Lab/vital/measurement candidate; route to numeric value/unit/status extraction instead of present/absent assertion.
actions.context_only: Useful context cue for assertion, experiencer, temporality, section, or value interpretation, but not a standalone target.

score_bin_policy.override: Reject/context-only still wins for generic, administrative, unit, route, header, person-role-only, or modifier spans.
Review high-risk abbreviations and category-specific artifacts.
Keep only strong multi-word clinical concepts or parsed lab/vital values.
Reject unless strong clinical phrase, family/social target, or parsed lab/vital value.
Allow review/value_parse for known lab abbreviations with a parsed value.
Allow value_parse only for strong lab/vital pattern with numeric value and unit/range context.

high_risk_false_positive_examples.observed_bad_or_ambiguous_mapping: MedCAT sometimes maps EF to Epilepsy even when the local text means ejection fraction.
high_risk_false_positive_examples.preferred_handling: If EF has nearby percent, LVEF/ejection-fraction wording, echo/TTE/cardiology context, heart-failure/cardiomyopathy context, or low/normal EF wording, override/review as Left ventricular ejection fraction rather than accepting the raw MedCAT concept.

high_risk_false_positive_examples.observed_bad_or_ambiguous_mapping: Patient, physiotherapist, physical therapy, or prothrombin time depending on context
high_risk_false_positive_examples.preferred_handling: Never label directly from PT alone. Value-parse and override to prothrombin time if PT/PTT/INR or coagulation-lab context; context-only if physical therapy/rehab or pulse exam.

high_risk_false_positive_examples.observed_bad_or_ambiguous_mapping: Table-style coagulation panels can make a generic regex attach the whole PT/PTT fraction to INR or leave PT as Patient.
high_risk_false_positive_examples.preferred_handling: Parse PT/PTT/INR panels before generic lab regex. Extract PT and PTT as seconds and INR as unitless; normalize PT/PTT/INR concepts in coag-lab context.

high_risk_false_positive_examples.observed_bad_or_ambiguous_mapping: A generic context-wide regex can attach a value from an earlier same-name mention rather than the local evidence span.
high_risk_false_positive_examples.preferred_handling: For value_parse, prefer the nearest local same-label value around the linker span. If the local mention has no concrete value, demote to review_candidate or context_only instead of emitting a strict numeric target.

high_risk_false_positive_examples.observed_bad_or_ambiguous_mapping: Clinical notes often write approximate values such as HR increased to the 160s or O2 sat 50-60%.
high_risk_false_positive_examples.preferred_handling: Preserve range/approximate text as numeric_value and value_text when locally attached to the lab/vital span; do not normalize away the uncertainty marker.
Allow only longer imaging spans such as head CT, CTA, CT abdomen, CT chest, or radiology procedure context.

high_risk_false_positive_examples.observed_bad_or_ambiguous_mapping: Can be myocardial infarction or nonclinical abbreviation
high_risk_false_positive_examples.preferred_handling: Require cardiology context and disease-like concept; otherwise review.

high_risk_false_positive_examples.observed_bad_or_ambiguous_mapping: Can map to non-ejection-fraction concepts or modifiers

high_risk_false_positive_examples.preferred_handling: Use as medication administration context only.
Use only to set experiencer/context for nearby disease concepts.

section_policy.policy: Use section as evidence for context and routing, never as the only reason to assert present/absent.

note_category_policy.Discharge summary: Keep high-confidence diagnoses, symptoms, procedures, meds, devices, and parsed labs; review history/negation-heavy sentences.
note_category_policy.Physician: Keep high-confidence clinical concepts; lab/vitals require value_parse; reject unit/route/admin spans.
note_category_policy.Consult: Keep high-confidence clinical concepts; lab/vitals require value_parse; tighten negation scope.
note_category_policy.ECG: Keep/review ECG-specific findings such as sinus rhythm, atrial fibrillation, ST/T-wave findings, bradycardia/tachycardia, block, and myocardial infarction. Context-only for previous/prior/change/possible unless attached to a finding.
note_category_policy.Echo: Do not treat normal/mild/size/wall/function/ventricular/aortic valve as independent targets. Use them as attributes around valve/chamber/function findings; value_parse LVEF/EF with percentage.
note_category_policy.Radiology: Reject report headers and admin spans such as reason/final report/examination/study/year. Review anatomy/procedure/findings; keep specific abnormalities only with clinical phrase context.
note_category_policy.Pharmacy: Keep medication/sedation/substance concepts; route/dose/admin words are context_only or reject.
note_category_policy.Nutrition: Labs, weights, vitals, diet/TPN/tube feeding require value/status parsing; reject standalone units.
note_category_policy.Respiratory: Keep airway, ventilation, lung sound, secretion, and respiratory support concepts when specific; reject assessment/plan/day/size/current.
note_category_policy.Nursing: Keep specific symptoms/devices/procedures/meds; reject action/assessment/plan/shift/admin spans; value_parse vitals.
note_category_policy.Nursing/other: Same as Nursing; neonatal/infant context should be preserved if present.
note_category_policy.Rehab Services: Treat PT/OT/ADL/mobility as functional/context candidates; do not confuse PT with prothrombin time.
note_category_policy.Case Management: Mostly social/admin. Keep social determinants such as smoker, lives with family, homelessness, occupation only when explicit; person roles are context_only.
note_category_policy.Social Work: Mostly social/family/admin. Keep social determinants and family-history disease context; person names/roles/contact fields are context_only or reject.
note_category_policy.General: Use standard clinical rules; reject generic admin/action spans.

lab_value_policy.principle: Lab/vital mentions are measurements or observations. Do not assign ordinary present/absent assertion from generic negation scope.
lab_value_policy.numeric_value_policy: Extract nearby numeric value, comparator, range, and unit when present. The value must align to the same local mention as the evidence span; repeated table rows or repeated same-name labs must not borrow values from earlier mentions. If no local concrete value is present, emit review_candidate/context_only rather than a final assertion pair.
lab_value_policy.value_status_policy: Use explicit terms high/low/elevated/decreased/normal/abnormal/positive/negative when present. Do not infer normality from reference ranges until a structured range source is added.
recommended_sources: MIMIC structured LABEVENTS and D_LABITEMS for numeric value grounding in later stages
note-local regex only for nearby lab/vital patterns such as Hgb 7.1, Hct 41, WBC 20, BP 128/57, HR 75, pCO2 54

assertion_policy.family_history_policy: Family history concepts must be experiencer=family and should not conflict with patient-current disease assertions. Family contact words such as husband/daughter/mother in case-management text are context roles unless the section/text states family history or a relative's disease history.
assertion_policy.scope_warning: Negation, possible, hypothetical, and historical cues must be scoped tightly to the concept sentence/clause; this filter only creates a preview, not final labels.

input_must_include: linker candidates with span, concept_id, concept_id_system, canonical_name, type_ids, score_bin, score
parsed value fields for lab/vital candidates
target_must_include: selected concept_id or mapped UMLS CUI
do_not_train_on: lab/vital mentions without parsed value/status when a value target is required

2026-05-14-v2.4.11.purpose: Tighten automatic target acceptance after LLM/manual audit of 170 v2.4.10 gold-sample records.
main_changes: Do not auto-accept generic headings/modifiers as strict target pairs.
Treat calcium and similar analytes in medication sections as doses/supplements, not lab values.
Downshift echo/anatomy attributes and exam locations unless they are specific findings.
Avoid forcing experiencer=family for mixed SOCIAL and FAMILY HISTORY sections without relative disease context.
Use a longer bounded context window so rehab/vital tables preserve nearby values.

2026-05-14-v2.4.12.purpose: Small follow-up patch after v2.4.11 smoke checks.
main_changes: Parse rehab HR/BP/SpO2 table rows where RR is omitted.
Downshift oral-motor phrases such as does not suck but bites down away from Bite-wound targets.
